nodes.label: 11 Parallel Execution Tracks (Scaffolding, DB Schema, Analytics Worker, Ingestion, Computation, Landing, Dashboard, Backtesting, CI/CD, Demo, Deployment)
Finding 1: Virtual Threads Primary, WebFlux-Ready (No Dual-Mode Parity Requirement)
nodes.rationale: Virtual Threads + Spring MVC is the primary runtime. Shared service layer defined behind interfaces so WebFlux adapters can be added later without rewriting business logic. No dual-mode parity requirement or cross-stack consistency tests.

nodes.label: Finding 2: AIC Lag Selection Pushed Entirely into Python Analytics Worker via Arrow IPC
nodes.rationale: Java sends data once, receives optimal result. Arrow IPC replaces REST/JSON for high-throughput time-series transfer, eliminating serialization bottleneck for AIC loop and batch analytics.

nodes.label: Finding 5: Direct FRED/NY Fed Java Clients — No OpenBB on Critical Ingestion Path
nodes.rationale: Core ILI data sources fetched via direct lightweight Java HTTP clients. Removes OpenBB sidecar from critical ILI ingestion path. OpenBB reserved only for long-tail analytics (econometrics, factor analysis).

nodes.label: Proxy Divergence Guard (Detects T-Bill/SOFR Dislocation During Flight-to-Quality Events)
Dynamic Weighting for Zero-Variance Components (Redistributes Weight Among Valid Components)
nodes.rationale: Instead of masking stale data as neutral (0.0), redistributes weight among valid components when a component has zero variance. Prevents the ILI from being biased by a dead component being treated as neutral.

nodes.label: Arrow IPC for Sidecar Communication (Replaces REST/JSON for Time-Series Arrays)
Chronicle Queue on Dedicated Storage (tmpfs or Separate NVMe Partition)
nodes.rationale: tmpfs or separate NVMe partition prevents I/O contention with TimescaleDB during sustained ingestion buffer overflow.

nodes.label: Real-Time Aggregates (materialized_only=false — Transparent Live+Materialized Data Merge)
